title: A Generative Model for Higher-Order Network Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2611.24638v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conventional network representations inferred from multivariate time series describe statistical relationships between pairs of components, even when the underlying dynamics involve group interactions that cannot be represented by pairwise interactions alone. Several multivariate information-theoretic measures have been proposed to characterise dependence beyond pairs. However, due to a lack of systems with known generating mechanisms, these measures have not been carefully validated or compared for empirical use. To address this, we here introduce a generative model of stochastic network dynamics with pairwise and higher-order interactions specified by the user. The higher-order interactions are represented by directed hyperedges, and the model provides a controlled benchmark for evaluating information-theoretic measures. translated_title: 高阶网络动力学的生成模型
translated_abstract: 从多元时间序列推断的传统网络表示描述的是组件对之间的统计关系，即使潜在的动力学涉及无法仅用成对交互来表示的群体交互。已有若干多元信息论度量被提出来刻画超越成对关系的依赖性，然而由于缺乏具有已知生成机制的系统，这些度量尚未得到仔细验证或比较以供实证使用。为解决这一问题，我们在此引入了一个随机网络动力学的生成模型，其中的成对交互和高阶交互可由用户指定。高阶交互由有向超边表示，该模型为评估信息论度量提供了受控基准。仅去除高阶项即可得到仅含成对交互的参照。实验测试某种度量能否检测出……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个用户可自定义成对与高阶交互的随机网络动力学生成模型，以有向超边表示高阶交互，从而为验证和比较超越成对依赖的信息论度量提供了受控基准。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a generative model of stochastic network dynamics with user-specified pairwise and higher-order interactions represented by directed hyperedges, providing a controlled benchmark for validating and comparing information-theoretic measures beyond pairwise dependence.
